stage_A_scan.what: ns per probe of the 20,000-state scan at the real K = 600 base (KIC_PROF_MAX_STATES=20000, KIC_INDEX_THREADS=3 KIC_INDEX_BATCH_INV=1, KIC_ROOT_ALGEBRA=0 KIC_SPARSE_REDUCE=0 so the default carry-less fold path is the one measured)

arms.old2: A/A copy of the old binary

stage_A_scan.design: 7 rounds, arm order rotated by one per round (3 arms), pairing by round
stage_A_scan.statistic: ratio of medians new/old over rounds; 95% percentile bootstrap over rounds (10,000)
stage_A_scan.gate: clears only if median ratio <= 1/1.2 = 0.8333 AND bootstrap upper bound <= 0.90 (the T21 gate); otherwise recorded as not reaching 1.2x on the scan and not carried to end to end
stage_A_scan.validity: probes and hits identical in every run; A/A (old2) CI contains 1

stage_C_instruction_counts: callgrind collected Ir at K = 40, 2000 states, old and new, with the per-function lines; secondary deterministic evidence, no gate

stage_B_end_to_end.runs_only_if: the stage A gate clears; then the T20 harness pattern (3 pinned cores, KIC_RANK_THREADS=3, same base/target/seed 7) under a fresh frozen protocol file, arms old and new, order C1 T1 C2
stage_B_end_to_end.otherwise: not run; the scan result is the T22 result

inadmissible: changing binaries, arms, rounds or gate after timing
dropping a round for being slow
reporting a scan ratio as an end-to-end speedup
using asm line counts as a result
report: observation; no S claim (counted S identical by construction); wall time secondary
